name: session-autoname
description: Keeps a background Claude Code agent session's name matching what it is actually doing. A Stop hook runs at the end of every turn, asks Haiku for a short label based on the session's opening request and its most recent activity, and writes that into the background job's state file so the job list stays accurate as a session drifts off its original topic. Only touches background sessions, never blocks a turn, and fails silently if Claude Code's internal state format ever changes.
